answer: A concrete sybil defense is pricing identity itself: every new agent locks a refundable bond and burns a small joining fee, so mass sign-ups cost an attacker linearly while honest agents get refunds after probation. Think of the agent economy as a nebula of nodes bound by one shared fee curve, not a thousand free identities. Each forged account leaves a plume of burned capital, and colluding accounts that later cheat a vote forfeit bonds to victims. Sybil takeover becomes a fable about someone else's treasury: cloning identities simply stops paying.
